parsed.rationale_overall: System B demonstrates stronger personalization by citing specific profile values (loss comfort 3/10, $3,800 expenses, $72k income, house goal target) and provides more concrete actionable numbers (specific dollar transfers, monthly amounts tied to the user's actual cash flow).
